view: AP portable frontal chest radiograph (marker "AP PORTABLE", L marker on image right = patient's left; conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Suboptimal: image tilted/rotated a few degrees counter-clockwise, low lung volumes, chin/mandible and scapulae overlap the apices, patient slightly rotated; penetration adequate; both costophrenic angles included; supine/semi-erect AP magnification of the mediastinum expected.

devices.location: Right paramediastinal, from neck level down to the diaphragm

abnormalities.finding: Patchy, hazy perihilar and basal airspace/interstitial infiltrates, most conspicuous on this side; right hemidiaphragm partially obscured, costophrenic angle roughly preserved
Patchy perihilar and lower-zone infiltrates, less extensive than the right; left costophrenic angle preserved

Gracile, somewhat demineralized-appearing long bones (humeri) and slender ribs, suggesting a chronically ill / non-ambulatory child (consistent with the presence of a tracheostomy); no acute fracture seen

description_zh: AP 攜帶式胸部X光，影像略有傾斜且肺容積偏低，下頜與肩胛骨重疊於上肺野。頸部正中可見氣切管，另見多枚心電圖電極與導線，右側縱膈旁另有一條細管影（疑為鼻胃/餵食管）向下延伸至橫膈附近。雙側肺門周圍及中下肺野可見斑片狀模糊浸潤，以右側中下肺野較為明顯，右側橫膈部分被遮蔽，雙側肋膈角大致仍可辨識。心縱膈影偏寬（AP 投照放大效應需納入考量），骨骼顯得纖細，未見明顯氣胸或大量肋膜積液，亦無胸管。
